input_access_order.description: Read PDF skill and Stage 2 prompt; attempted package-root START_HERE.md was absent and returned no contents; listed stage2 filenames. No Lean mathematical contents read.

Rendered all 23 PDF pages with Ghostscript, then visually inspected critical pages 2,3,9,10,12,14,15,16,17,18,19,20,22,23; serialized independent source inventory before Stage 1 or Lean target/definition access.

First post-inventory parallel batch read target statements and explicit-type supplement; source-coverage index and snapshot/interface instructions; and only the two permitted final frozen Stage 1 files. Their hashes were checked.

Read exported definition dependencies and selected declaration records, reread the final Stage 1 report, and extracted native signatures/defining values from the modules enumerated as content-read inputs. Located supporting witnesses before the Results namespace, full finite-query equivalence, UUS witness, cover results, repetition equivalences, and least-name stabilization.

Verified all Stage 2 manifest entries and final Stage 1 hashes; visually inspected remaining PDF pages 1,4,5,6,7,8,11,13,21, completing visual review of all 23 pages; checked raw umbrella import list and standard-library boundary; completed the report and added explicit cap-history ambiguity.

Validated all eight dossiers, 37 matrix rows, report length, unchanged independently recorded inventory prefix, explicit root-name set, page labels, and QA count; serialized final run manifest and froze both deliverables.

findings.headline_components: Located native statement coverage for all numbered theorem, lemma and corollary statements in the complete independent inventory. This is a statement comparison, not a proof certification.
findings.material_object_difference: Theorem 1.1 named native pair differs from the source proof pair; native first class is countable. Headline existence is retained.
unresolved_source_issues: 6.3 proof isolated uniform-feedback wording versus eventual statement
6.5 literal arbitrary-sequence cap versus surrounding legal-response convention; native cap covers all compatible histories
6.7 binary-tree edge reversal and algorithm-number mismatch
4.17 invariant includes zero while construction omits its marker set
Appendix A copied non-uniform wording, undefined d-star and distinct-count indexing
findings.stage1_corrections: No material semantic correction to the final frozen reconstruction; extended interface-only scope using direct native statements and named assembly.
findings.effective_computability: Neither literal source definitions nor native types require ordinary or relative computability; no stronger algorithmic reading certified.

limitations: Backend revision and runtime configuration cannot be independently introspected.
Standard Lean/Mathlib meanings and exporter fidelity are trusted boundaries; no recursive external-body audit.
No new compilation, theorem proof review, effective implementation certification or human review.
Source proof-text ambiguities are recorded without repair; explanation adjudication remains Stage 3.
Report freezes read-only filesystem bytes, not immutable storage.
